title: Jerk Jamaican Cottage Cheese Flatbread
description: A twist on traditional flatbread, this recipe combines the flavors of jerk seasoning with the creaminess of cottage cheese and the crunch of a double-rise bread crust.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C) and a hot stone plate or baking sheet to 450°F (230°C).
Roll out the double-rise bread dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
In a small bowl, mix together the jerk seasoning, habanero pepper, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Spread the jerk seasoning mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Top the dough with the cottage cheese, spreading it evenly to cover the entire surface.
Fold the edges of the dough over the cottage cheese, pressing gently to seal.
Place the flatbread on the preheated hot stone plate or baking sheet and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and sprinkle with coconut oil and fresh cilantro.
